name: Octree Voxel Storage
definition: A hierarchical data structure used to store voxel data efficiently by grouping adjacent voxels of the same type into larger cells, reducing memory usage for sparse or uniform regions compared to flat arrays.
summary: Octree Voxel Storage is a hierarchical structure that groups adjacent identical voxels to reduce memory usage for sparse data, differing from flat arrays by trading direct access for logarithmic traversal.
